## Key Concepts

**Poisson regression**

Typically you use the Poisson regression when your dependent (outcome_ variable is a count of discrete events (sch as the number of goals scored, hospital visits, crime incidents , etc.). It is preferred to logistic regression because it models rarer events. 

Poisson regression assumes that the variance and the mean are around the same number. If they are not and the conditional variance is substantially greater than the mean, then use a negative binomial regression.
